sentences.target: Dobrý deň, ako sa máte?
sentences.english: Good day, how are you?

sentences.target: Volám sa Martin a som zo Slovenska.
sentences.english: My name is Martin and I am from Slovakia.

sentences.target: Veľmi ma teší, že vás spoznávam.
sentences.english: Very nice to meet you.

sentences.target: Pochádzam z Košíc, ale teraz bývam v Bratislave.
sentences.english: I come from Košice, but now I live in Bratislava.

sentences.target: Hovorím po anglicky a trochu po slovensky.
sentences.english: I speak English and a little Slovak.

sentences.target: Dám si kávu s mliekom a jablkový koláč, prosím.
sentences.english: I will have a coffee with milk and an apple cake, please.

sentences.target: Koľko to stojí?
sentences.english: How much does this cost?

sentences.target: Môžem zaplatiť kartou?
sentences.english: Can I pay by card?

sentences.target: Zaplatím, prosím.
sentences.english: I would like to pay, please.

sentences.target: Toto jedlo je veľmi chutné.
sentences.english: This food is very tasty.

sentences.target: Každý deň vstávam o siedmej ráno.
sentences.english: Every day I get up at seven in the morning.

sentences.target: Pijem čaj a raňajkujem v kuchyni.
sentences.english: I drink tea and eat breakfast in the kitchen.

sentences.target: Do práce chodím električkou alebo autobusom.
sentences.english: I go to work by tram or bus.

sentences.target: Večer rád čítam knihu alebo počúvam hudbu.
sentences.english: In the evening I like to read a book or listen to music.

sentences.target: Moja rodina býva v Žiline.
sentences.english: My family lives in Žilina.

sentences.target: Prepáčte, kde je najbližšia železničná stanica?
sentences.english: Excuse me, where is the nearest train station?

sentences.target: Včera sme boli s priateľmi v Slovenskom národnom divadle.
sentences.english: Yesterday we were at the Slovak National Theatre with friends.

sentences.target: Budúci víkend pôjdeme na výlet do Vysokých Tatier.
sentences.english: Next weekend we will go on a trip to the High Tatras.

sentences.target: Keby som mal viac voľného času, učil by som sa hrať na klavíri.
sentences.english: If I had more free time, I would learn to play the piano.

sentences.target: Napriek tomu, že pršalo celý deň, prechádzka historickým centrom sa nám páčila.
sentences.english: Although it rained all day, we enjoyed the walk through the historic centre.
